entities.name: RRC connection release procedure
entities.description: Network-initiated procedure to transition UE between RRC states or release and redirect UE to another frequency.

entities.name: RRC_CONNECTED
entities.description: RRC state where UE has an active connection with the network.

entities.name: RRC_IDLE
entities.description: RRC state where UE is not actively connected to the network.

entities.name: RRC_INACTIVE
entities.description: RRC state where UE maintains some context but is not actively transmitting.

entities.name: SRB2 and at least one DRB or multicast MRB setup condition
entities.description: Condition required for transitioning from RRC_CONNECTED to RRC_INACTIVE, requiring SRB2 and at least one DRB or multicast MRB to be setup.

entities.name: Release and redirect to another frequency
entities.description: Procedure behavior that releases the current connection and redirects UE to another frequency.

relations.description: Procedure requires UE to be in RRC_CONNECTED state for transition to RRC_IDLE or RRC_INACTIVE.
Procedure establishes transition from RRC_CONNECTED to RRC_IDLE.
Procedure establishes transition from RRC_CONNECTED to RRC_INACTIVE when conditions are met.
Transition to RRC_INACTIVE from RRC_CONNECTED is guarded by SRB2 and DRB setup condition.
Procedure can establish release and redirect behavior to another frequency.
Procedure establishes transition from RRC_INACTIVE back to RRC_INACTIVE during resume attempt.
Procedure establishes transition from RRC_INACTIVE to RRC_IDLE during resume attempt.
